77969.subject: How to Turn Claude Fable 5 Into a McKinsey-Level Consulting Engine 🧠
77969.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/claude-fable-5-mckinsey-consulting-engine

👋 Hey, Linas here! Every day, I break down 3 stories shaping the future of FinTech & Artificial Intelligence - plus the money movements and trends worth tracking. First time here? 399k+ FinTech and AI leaders get this daily. Join them:
Companies paid McKinsey, BCG and Bain about $37 billion last year for advice. Most of the work on any engagement was done by someone who joined the firm less than 2 years ago. McKinsey has hired straight from graduate school since 1953, and it was the first firm to do so on purpose.
That only makes sense if the associate is not what the client is buying.
The client is buying a method: the same questions in the same order, the same test on every claim before it reaches a slide, the same structure on every document so a CEO reads page one and knows the answer. The associate delivers it. The method is the product.
The method is not secret. Minto’s Pyramid Principle, Lafley and Martin’s Playing to Win, Kaplan and Norton’s Balanced Scorecard, Heuer’s declassified CIA handbook on competing hypotheses: all published, all readable by the end of the quarter. Reading was never the constraint. The constraint was the two years it takes to turn those books into reflex, under deadline, with a partner checking your logic at every step. Nobody outside the firms had that, so everyone else bought it back at partner rates.
A frontier model like Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/352ca83f-4dab-4e84-ad78-3ecbed837dfe?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] can now run that method with more discipline than a second-year associate, provided someone writes it down in a form the model can execute: steps in order, a checkpoint at each one, the tests a partner applies, a worked example, and the mistakes that produce plausible nonsense.
That is exactly what this guide gives you. Twelve Claude Skills [ https://substack.com/redirect/1fbead18-1814-4ea2-830c-b46d45927597?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] built on the published frameworks, written to one specification and verified against primary sources. Two were tested head-to-head against the same model with no skill loaded: with the skills, the model passed 95-97% of a partner-level checklist; without them, 38-67%. All the details are in the “Proof” section.
All twelve are free to download at the end of this guide. Install them, and Claude stops answering strategy questions like a well-read generalist and starts working like a firm.
In this guide:
Why frameworks beat prompts
The engine: how the 12 skills fit together
The 12 skills, one by one
Running an engagement end to end (with the exact prompts)
Proof: how the skills were built, verified, and tested
How this connects to the earlier guides
Download and install (all 12 skills, three ways)
Getting the most out of it, and where it falls short
FAQ

**Welcome back!** Nvidia is reportedly spending $6 billion to build an American answer to DeepSeek. WikiHow is taking OpenAI to court over its how-to articles, Anthropic's job interview asks recruits about a worthless stock, and Bernie Sanders says the country came around to stopping AI.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Nvidia:** What is it buying for $6 billion?

* **OpenAI:** Who's dragging it to court now?

* **Anthropic:** What does it ask before hiring you?

* **Bernie:** Why is he claiming victory over AI?


----------



----------
## Nvidia pays $6B to take down DeepSeek

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/e1379ca0-9c41-4434-9681-1cb7abc82875/hf_20260824_212104_57f96f3c-a3f0-4f73-aa48-6869b36d2abd.png?t=1787606581)
Caption: 

Nvidia is reportedly paying $6 billion to [license Poolside's technology](https://www.wsj.com/tech/ai/nvidia-is-spending-6-billion-to-build-a-powerful-u-s-alternative-to-chinese-ai-c51c38cc), per the Wall Street Journal, plus about $1 billion invested in the startup at a $12 billion valuation. More than 100 Poolside engineers move over to work on Nemotron, Nvidia's open-weight model project.

The target is obvious. DeepSeek, Kimi K3 and Qwen turned open-weight AI into a Chinese home game, with Kimi shipping 2.8 trillion parameters for free last month while American labs kept their best weights locked.

Nvidia doesn’t like that.

The strategy pays twice, since every open model tuned for Nvidia hardware sells more Nvidia hardware. Yesterday's spending data showed businesses picking cheap open models. That's the market Nvidia just bid to own.

77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
